sequence.title: 4. API Authentication Handshake & Sequence (Sequence Diagram)
sequence.code:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Client User
    participant GW as API Gateway
    participant Auth as Identity Provider (IAM)
    participant Svc as Core API Service
    participant DB as Secure Vault Storage

    User->>GW: 1. HTTPS POST /login
    GW->>Auth: 2. Validate Credentials & MFA
    Auth-->>GW: 3. Issue Signed JWT Bearer Token
    GW-->>User: 4. 200 OK (JWT Token)
    User->>GW: 5. GET /api/v1/assets (Bearer Token)
    GW->>Svc: 6. Forward Authorized Request
    Svc->>DB: 7. Query Encrypted Records
    DB-->>Svc: 8. Return Dataset
    Svc-->>User: 9. 200 OK JSON Response

    ASSET_SYSTEM ||--o{ AUDIT_LOG : tracks

    ASSET_SYSTEM ||--o{ VULN_FINDING : contains

        string remediation_status
    }
    CVE_REFERENCE {
        string cve_id PK
        float cvss_score

    }

templates.pipeline:
SOP Execution Pipeline

PHASE 01
Triage & Notification

Automated alerts trigger incident assessment and mobilize response teams.

PHASE 02
Containment & Isolation

Isolate compromised nodes, restrict lateral movement, and preserve forensics logs.

PHASE 03
Remediation & Validation

Deploy clean images or failover to standby, validating data integrity prior to cutover.

PHASE 04
Post-Mortem & Archival

Generate root-cause analysis (RCA), update defensive playbooks, and archive logs.
templates.matrix:
Decision Priority Matrix (Quadrant 2x2)

Quadrant I (High Impact | Low Cost)

Quick Wins

  • Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) across privileged access
  • Automate vulnerability scans and schedule hotpatching
Quadrant II (High Impact | High Cost)

Strategic Initiatives

  • Multi-region active-active disaster recovery upgrade
  • Organization-wide Zero Trust identity perimeter adoption
Quadrant III (Low Impact | Low Cost)

Routine Maintenance

  • Periodic endpoint inventory reconciliation and audits
  • Routine integrity checks on backup snapshots
Quadrant IV (Low Impact | High Cost)

Deprioritize

  • In-house UI redesign for non-critical legacy systems
  • Redundant custom monitoring script development
templates.action_board:
As-Is vs. To-Be Action Board

[!] As-Is Pain Points & Risks

  • Manual approval workflows with turnaround times exceeding 72 hours
  • Decentralized datacenter logs lacking unified search and alerting
  • Irregular permission reviews leading to dormant privileged accounts

[+] To-Be Architecture & Solutions

  • Automated CI/CD pipelines reducing routine approvals to under 2 hours
  • Centralized SIEM data lake with 365-day retention and automated response
  • Enterprise PAM implementation with mandatory credential rotation
